Join the CDUTCM-Keele Joint Health and Medical Sciences Institute in China as a Lecturer or Senior Lecturer in Public Health Management. Main tasks include delivering high-quality teaching in public health, mentoring students, supervising undergraduate research, and building a research profile. Key requirements include a PhD in Public Health Management or a closely related field, higher education teaching experience, and an emerging or established research profile. Deadline: 10 Dec 2026. Advertisement: https://www.timeshighereducation.com/unijobs/listing/415440/lecturer-senior-lecturer-in-public-health-management/

item.title: Assistant / Associate / Full Professor in Master / Ph.D. Program in Clinical Genomics and Proteomics
item.description: Faculty – TAIPEI MEDICAL UNIVERSITY (TMU), Taipei, Taiwan. Taipei Medical University seeks an Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor for the Master or Ph.D. Program in Clinical Genomics and Proteomics within the College of Pharmacy. Main tasks include conducting high-quality research, teaching in English, securing funding, and mentoring students. Requirements include a Ph.D. in a relevant discipline, postdoctoral training, and expertise in genomics, translational medicine, or related fields. Deadline: 30 Nov 2026. Advertisement: https://www.timeshighereducation.com/unijobs/listing/416243/assistant-associate-full-professor-in-master-ph-d-program-in-clinical-genomics-and-proteomics/?LinkSource=PremiumListing

item.title: Research Assistant Professor
item.description: Faculty – HONG KONG BAPTIST UNIVERSITY, Kowloon Tong, Hong Kong. This role involves designing and leading clinical research on Chinese herbal medicine drug development, securing extramural funding, and overseeing interventional trials as Principal Investigator. Key requirements include a PhD in a biomedical field, postdoctoral experience, and at least three years of hands-on experience in conducting clinical trials. Deadline: 29 Nov 2026. Advertisement: https://www.timeshighereducation.com/unijobs/listing/416070/research-assistant-professor-centre-for-chinese-herbal-medicine-drug-development/?LinkSource=PremiumListing
